artifacts.title: Fridge Magnet With Harbour Light
artifacts.coverLine: A small skyline held the whole evening in miniature.

chapters.title: The souvenir remembers the light first.
chapters.body: The magnet arrived home with a little theatrical confidence: brass windows, red tramlines, and a harbor that still felt warm from the walk back.

chapters.title: A route traced in receipts, rain, and ferry glass.
chapters.body: The trip moved slowly through markets, museum rooms, steep streets, and late platforms. The object is less proof of place than a bookmark for the pace of being there.
chapters.detail: Collection note: pair with ambient audio after exhibit entry.

chapters.title: Returned to the kitchen, still catalogued as elsewhere.
chapters.body: On the fridge it becomes ordinary again. In EverAfter, the same object opens like a quiet gallery label and lets the journey breathe for a minute longer.
chapters.detail: Local exhibit. No cloud sync required.

artifacts.title: Station Ticket Stub
artifacts.coverLine: A paper rectangle from a morning of temples and rain.

chapters.title: The platform clock held the first memory.
chapters.body: A stub saved between pages, creased at one corner, still carrying the exactness of a departure board.

chapters.title: Stone paths, cedar shade, and soft station bells.
chapters.body: The exhibit keeps the sequence sparse: a gate, a train, a bowl of noodles, and a long walk back under umbrellas.

chapters.title: Filed under motion.
chapters.body: The ticket is fragile, so the memory becomes the object you can handle.
chapters.detail: Local exhibit. Ready for future NFC binding.

artifacts.title: Black Sand Vial
artifacts.coverLine: A storm kept in a bottle without making a sound.

chapters.title: The shore was nearly monochrome.
chapters.body: Wind pressed every sentence flat. The sand looked like ground ink and made the horizon feel older than the trip.

chapters.title: Weather as the main exhibit.
chapters.body: The route is remembered by what had to be leaned into: rain, wool, hot soup, and a road disappearing into white.
chapters.detail: Suggested media: map and low ambient audio.

chapters.title: A landscape small enough to shelve.
chapters.body: The vial keeps the scale impossible, which is why it belongs in the museum.
chapters.detail: Local exhibit. Ready for future NFC binding.
